attributes.name: ypy-lazy
attributes.description: The URL of a GET request made when the element is about to be seen; the response replaces the element (`ypy-swap` changes that). The content of the element is the placeholder.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-placeholder
attributes.description: A selector of a `<template>` (or element) whose content replaces the children of the region when it is processed.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-error
attributes.description: A selector of a `<template>` (or element) whose content replaces the children of the region when it fails to load.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-retry
attributes.description: On an element inside a lazy region: loads the region again when clicked after an error.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-group
attributes.description: A group name for a lazy region. Regions of the same group that come into view within `lazy.window` load with one GET request, which asks for the `id` of each region and which the server answers with one `<ypy-partial id>` per region. A region without an `id`, or alone in its window, loads on its own.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-group-url
attributes.description: The URL of the group request, on any region of the group (the first region that has it wins). Without it the request goes to the `ypy-lazy` URL of the first region of the batch.

events.name: ypy:lazy:error
events.description: A region with `ypy-lazy` failed to load (no connection, a status of 400 or more, a swap error). The region has `data-ypy-state="error"`.

events.name: ypy:lazy:group
events.description: Fires on the first region of a batch just before the group request is sent. `ids` lists the `id` of every region in it.

config.name: lazy.margin
config.description: How far outside the window a region is loaded, as a CSS margin.

config.name: lazy.window
config.description: How long a region of a group waits for the others to come into view before the group is requested, in milliseconds or as a time such as `"50ms"`.

headers.name: YPY-Lazy-Group
headers.description: The name of the group on the request that loads several lazy regions at once. The `id` of each region is in the query string, next to `group`.
